provenance: The example images are the approved TWO agent avatars. They were AI-generated for TWO with an image-generation model before this tool existed; they are stored byte-for-byte as approved. Each recipe is the preset and prompt this tool uses to generate a new variant in the same style, not a record of the exact original prompt. Image generation is non-deterministic.

parameters.face: happy closed eyes drawn as two upward arcs (^ ^), a calm friendly smile
accessories: a golden clipboard held in its left hand

request.prompt:
Create one new character in exactly the same art style as the reference image(s): a cohesive, chunky pixel-art mascot with a large fluffy cloud-shaped head/helmet, a dark rounded-rectangle screen as its face, a small rounded body with stubby arms and legs, thick dark pixel outlines and simple stepped shading. Keep the same proportions, pixel size, outline weight, framing and centered front-facing pose as the references.

Character: Chief of Staff.
Color palette (butter yellow): head and body #fde99f, highlights #fbf0c8, outlines and shadows #5e4725, face screen #300001, glowing face symbols #f0e8a0. Recolor the whole character to this palette; do not copy the colors of the reference images.
Face: happy closed eyes drawn as two upward arcs (^ ^), a calm friendly smile, glowing in #f0e8a0 on the dark screen.
Chest emblem: none.
Accessories: a small maroon necktie; a golden clipboard held in its left hand.

Background: fully transparent (alpha channel), no floor, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border. Exactly one character, centered with a small even margin.
